skill.summary: Use when generating JUnit 5 + Mockito unit tests for Java/Maven source code, especially for incremental changes on a git branch. Activates when user asks to...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Increment Code Unit Test Creator for Java/Maven projects.
- Generates JUnit 5 + Mockito unit tests for incremental code changes detected via Git.
- Supports both full class test generation and precise, diff-based test updates.
- Automatically checks and manages test dependencies in Maven (`pom.xml`) based on JDK version.
- Provides detailed rules for test method naming, coverage scenarios, and mock strategies.
- Focuses on meaningful test object construction and skips boilerplate or redundant tests.
